title: Uspenski Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual Uspenski Cathedral, Helsinki: red-brick cross-shaped upper church, round east apses, stepped low corner/side roofs, tall polygonal brick drum with round-arched glazing, tiered green copper helmet and gold onion/cross; four medium roof turrets, eight smaller corner pyramids/gold tips, lower southern bell/vestibule tower and link, and projecting western gabled open porch with grey granite columns and wood entrance. Shared brick/granite/copper/wood, linear tints, metric UVs, flat architectural normals and four browser levels. Standard terrain foundations. Exact ornamental brick/sculpture/inscriptions, glass artwork, hidden roofs and room plans, neighboring buildings, surveyed hill/plaza grading and certified walking excluded.
